name: SetEmailHandling
description: Sets the handling state of one or more inbound emails from the inbox screen: לא טופל, ממתין (requires waitingFor; sets waitingSince) or טופל (sets handledBy and handledAt). Moving away from טופל clears handledBy / handledAt; moving away from ממתין clears waitingFor / waitingSince. Writes one Interactions row per email for a linked customer. Sends nothing.

waitingFor.description: Required for ממתין: who we wait for

by.description: Display name of the person changing the state

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Closing a mail**: "סימון טופל" at the top of the mail panel on the Inbox page (פניות → דואר נכנס), opened by clicking a mail
  Marks the mail as handled (shown in green) with who closed it and when; its 24-hour ring stops.
- **Putting a mail on hold**: "סימון ממתין" in the same panel, then writing who we wait for (e.g. "ממתין ללקוח") and confirming
  Marks the mail as waiting, with for whom and since when.
- **Reopening a mail**: "החזרה ל״לא טופל״" in the same panel
  Puts the mail back in the open list.
- **Handling several mails at once**: tick mails in the inbox list, then the same three buttons in the bar above the list
  Changes the handling state of all the ticked mails together.
